summary: Both backend and frontend verified against the new Storyboard Generation Engine sprint. Backend: 27/27 pytest PASSED. Updated test_storyboard_api.py::test_generate_returns_full_package to assert the NEW concept schema {title, elevator_pitch, main_message, emotional_goal, audience, communication_objective} and NEW treatment schema {visual_style, narrative_style, camera_language, editing_style, lighting_style, color_palette, sound_design, overall_mood}, and to send num_scenes=3 while asserting the resulting scenes are clamped to 8-12 (real AI returned 8) — clamp verified. Existing coverage for regenerate-dialogue (dialogue/voice_over/on_screen_text updated, shot_size/camera_angle UNCHANGED) and regenerate-camera (camera fields updated, dialogue/voice_over UNCHANGED), regenerate-scene, regenerate-image-prompt, auth (register/login/me/reset), 12 categorized templates, projects CRUD, ownership isolation, duplicate, delete→404, all pass. Real AI mode confirmed (mock_mode:false at GET /api/). Frontend E2E (390x844) on the seeded project c73286507b42 (Solstice Perfume, 8 scenes): logged in as sb_1785767871@studio.com → project loaded → Storyboard tab renders progress header (Total Duration 30s · Total Scenes 8 · Est. Shooting Time 6.8 hrs) → each scene is a collapsed card (number, title, duration, shot type, location) → toggle-{i} expands it and reveals ALL fields plus a labelled AI IMAGE PROMPT block → RegenChips (regen-dialogue-{i}, regen-camera-{i}, regen-prompt-{i}) and IconBtns (edit-{i}, regen-{i}, dup-{i}, up-{i}, down-{i}, del-{i}) all render inside the expanded card and are tappable → Move Down (down-0) reorders First Light from position 1 to 2 → header immediately shows 'All changes saved' → reload persists the new order → Move Up (up-1) restores original order → Add Scene increments 8→9 (autosaves) and Delete brings it back to 8 → Overview tab renders ALL new concept keys (ELEVATOR PITCH, MAIN MESSAGE, EMOTIONAL GOAL, AUDIENCE, COMMUNICATION OBJECTIVE) AND ALL 8 treatment keys (VISUAL STYLE, NARRATIVE STYLE, CAMERA LANGUAGE, EDITING STYLE, LIGHTING STYLE, COLOR PALETTE, SOUND DESIGN, OVERALL MOOD) as labeled key/value rows — no raw paragraphs. Long-press drag handle (drag-{i}) is present; on web the DraggableFlatList long-press gesture is impractical to automate, but reorder was verified authoritatively through Move Up/Down + reload persistence. No React Native red screens, no deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch), no blocking bugs. All 8 features from the review request pass.
action_items: None blocking. Optional non-blocking web-only console warnings observed: 'shadow*' style props deprecated in react-native-web (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (use style.pointerEvents). These are RN-Web deprecation notices, not runtime failures — safe to address in a cleanup pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py build_prompt: concept and treatment JSON schemas now match the new object keys requested by the sprint (title/elevator_pitch/main_message/emotional_goal/audience/communication_objective and visual_style/narrative_style/camera_language/editing_style/lighting_style/color_palette/sound_design/overall_mood). Confirmed by real-AI pytest run.
server.py generate: scene count is clamped with n = min(12, max(8, int(num_scenes or 8))) — verified at runtime: sending num_scenes=3 still yielded 8 scenes.
server.py mock fallback (mock_output) mirrors the same new concept/treatment keys — schema is consistent whether AI succeeds or falls back.
server.py _regen_partial cleanly restricts writes to the requested field-set — pytest asserts unrelated fields (shot_size/camera_angle vs dialogue/voice_over) are not touched.
